ETH and SOL are especially vulnerable due to elevated beta, volatility, and negative alpha. BCH, DOGE, and LTC lack constructive breadth and have weak institutional/liquidity inputs. ETC is materially fragile: its zero price and zeroed risk fields indicate invalid or missing data, so its long signal should not be trusted.
